description:
Scope: planning-only coverage for lib/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/archive_channel_connector.ex lines 30, 34, 38; one test-only step. Exclusive test path to ADD: test/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/archive_channel_connector_test.exs. Do not edit connector_action_schema_test.exs, refresh_channel_history_membership_test.exs or ConnectorLifecycle implementation. No production, docs, or agent-tool changes; no new Action or E2E. Existing schema/property coverage lives in connector_action_schema_test.exs; lifecycle behavior in test/zaq/engine/connector_lifecycle_test.exs and connector_archive_persistence_test.exs.

Functional specification / test-first step: exercise the existing ArchiveChannelConnector Action via Jido.Exec.run/3 with validated atom-key params %{channel_config_id: config.id, provider: "mattermost", kind: "retrieval"} and trusted %{actor: %{user_id: current_user.id}, opts: [router: local_router_fake]}; use direct run/2 only for malformed-shape guard that validated Exec would reject first. The Action checks BOActor.current_user/1 and delegates to ConnectorLifecycle.archive/3. Actor must come from context, never params; archive returns {:ok, %{result: map}} or a domain error unchanged. BOActor guarantees a current non-password-blocked user, NOT a super-admin role by itself: do not assume the Action independently checks role; surface any administrator-only documentation mismatch to the owning task rather than encoding a false assertion.

Scenarios, test assertions and lines:
1) Success (30): create a current user with Zaq.AccountsFixtures.super_admin_fixture/0 and insert one enabled ChannelConfig via changeset/Repo.insert! with unique name, provider mattermost, kind retrieval, settings %{}. A small nested Router fake dispatch/1 accepts %Zaq.Event{}, sends the test process its action, actor and request for observation, and returns %{event | response: {:ok, :deleted}} for :connector_teardown_ingress or %{event | response: :ok} for :connector_sync_runtime; fail on unexpected action rather than blanket stubbing. With opts [router: Router], call Jido.Exec.run/3. Assert exact connector ID, :archived status, ingress/runtime and not_required watch/cleanup in wrapped result; assert two correctly scoped confidential events carry the same trusted actor; reload row and assert archived_at nonnil, enabled false. No network or watch side effects (retrieval). Use direct existing ConnectorLifecycle tests as reference, not duplicate their full matrices.
2) Domain failure (30 and 33): current user, exact-shaped params with nonexistent positive connector ID or wrong provider for existing ID, same optional fake router; expect {:error, :connector_not_found}, row unchanged if present, and no router events. Invalid/missing actor with a valid connector: expect {:error, :unauthorized}, row unchanged and no router events; an actor-looking ID inside params must not grant authority. Check unknown actor, person-only actor, and deleted/password-blocked actor only if supported fixture setup is stable; do not claim missing identity can archive.
3) Shape guard (38): direct run/2 on nonmap params with map context, and map params with nonmap context; assert {:error, :unauthorized} and no effects. Jido.Exec rejects malformed params earlier, so it cannot be used to target this guard.
4) Generic fallback (34): UNREACHABLE through supported public contracts: BOActor.current_user/1 returns only {:ok, user} or {:error, :unauthorized}; ConnectorLifecycle.archive/3 returns only {:ok, map} or {:error, reason} for normal calls, and raises rather than returning a third shape on exceptions. A fake router returning a strange response is converted to {:error, {:ingress_teardown_failed, ...}} or pending sync within lifecycle, still hitting 33 or success. Do not mock either internal module, use :meck, modify production, or invent a test-only callback merely to color line 34. Document the infeasible branch as a justified coverage exception; if a genuine production collaborator begins returning another shape, add a contract-level test then. Optionally owner may separately decide whether to remove the unreachable fallback, outside this issue.

Fixtures/helpers/isolation: use Zaq.DataCase, async: true, SQL sandbox; reuse Zaq.AccountsFixtures.super_admin_fixture and ChannelConfig changeset builder pattern in connector_lifecycle_test.exs; keep only minimal private insert helper if repeated. Router fake is local deterministic test module, not Mox because routing seam already exists in opts; do not mock BOActor, Repo, Lifecycle, or blanket NodeRouterMock. Calls are synchronous; assert sent %Zaq.Event{} messages with assert_received/refute_received; no sleeps or global app env. Generate unique names with System.unique_integer. No child processes or sandbox allowances needed. Property assessment: absent/invalid identity is a permission-default invariant; add a small bounded ExUnitProperties/StreamData property over supported invalid actor shapes (nil, %{}, %{person_id: positive}, %{user_id: negative}) against valid request, assert :unauthorized and no row mutation; keep setup outside generator and avoid accidental real user IDs. Existing connector_action_schema_test.exs already tests required fields, so avoid duplicate schema property. If property adds disproportionate DB work, document why representative negative examples plus existing property suffice; do not silently omit invariant assessment.

Action reuse assessment: no executable operation changes; reuse existing ArchiveChannelConnector and ConnectorLifecycle.archive/3. Candidate lib/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/archive_channel_connector.ex already wraps the owning domain API; workflows use StepRunner/Jido.Action, and programmatic tests use Jido.Exec.run/3. Inputs exact scoped ID/provider/kind, context actor/opts; outputs wrapped successful archive or propagated errors; side effects are watch teardown (data source only), Channels event dispatch, DB archive and runtime sync. No agent registry exposure, new operation, or extra Action; verify delegation and preserved scope. Documentation updates: none (test-only), except record line-34 exception in this issue and flag any role-doc mismatch for owner. E2E unnecessary: no UI journey or behavior change.

Validation after implementation (NOT in this planning task): run isolated mix test test/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/archive_channel_connector_test.exs through Context Mode, then mix q, inspect fresh coverage for lines 30/38 and realistic 33, record 34 infeasible and overall whole-file percentage/exception. Follow WORKFLOW_AGENT phase 4; once final reviewed changes are ready, coverage handoff and final mix precommit gate per phases 6, without masking regressions. No tests or Git commands/mutations in this planning task.
